item.title: Hornets Defeat Marceline, Improve to 10–7

item.title: Highway Patrol Arrest
item.description: An 18 year old Cowgill woman was arrested late Friday night in Livingston County by the Missouri Highway Patrol. Jodee Clariday is charged with alleged driving while intoxicated and exceeding the posted speed limit by up to 10 miles an hour. Clariday was arrested and released.
